title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We're excited to officially launch Spyglass, delivering powerful new capabilities to help you gain clarity and make smarter decisions.

title: Advanced File Control for Your Content
summary: Take full command of your content with new file management capabilities, allowing you to effortlessly upload, remove, download, and customize how files appear in your editor.

title: Public Product Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap page offers a clear view of our progress, upcoming features, and long-term vision, ensuring you always know what's next.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a smoother workflow with our redesigned checkboxes that are now bigger, easier to click and drag, and perfectly integrated with your workspace.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience a smoother, more intuitive real-time collaboration with improved indicators that clearly show what everyone is working on.

title: Enhanced Shared Content Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and access all relevant shared content directly within your searches, making collaboration seamless and keeping you connected to important ideas.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Noeko is now available in multiple languages, making our platform accessible to a worldwide audience.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: Noeko is now an open-source project, empowering our community with unprecedented control and the opportunity to shape its future directly.

title: Dynamic Constellation Insights
summary: Unlock deeper insights into your knowledge base with a redesigned Constellation view that offers powerful filtering by tags, time, and shared connections to streamline your workflow.

title: Advanced Search and Saved Collections
summary: Gain precise control over your information with new advanced search filters, sorting options, and the ability to save your tailored results as custom collections for instant recall.

title: Dynamic Note Views
summary: Organize your thoughts with greater ease as we roll out flexible new ways to display and interact with linked content directly within your notes, offering a clearer view of your connected ideas.

title: Noeko Premium and Self-Managed Deployment
summary: We are preparing Noeko for its public release, introducing powerful paid plans and the highly anticipated option to deploy it in your own environment.

title: Elevate Your Experience with New and Improved Themes
summary: We're overhauling existing themes to provide a more polished and user-friendly appearance, while also expanding our collection with stunning new visual styles.

title: Smarter Time-Aware Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your homepage always greets you with the perfect message, accurately reflecting the time of day wherever you are.

title: Effortless Tag List Management
summary: Efficiently manage and remove multiple items from your tags with new direct actions available within their respective list views, saving you valuable time.

title: Unlock New Content Sources
summary: Get ready to effortlessly connect all your valuable information, from YouTube videos and websites to text documents, enriching your knowledge base like never before.
